powerPlayPolicy: Positive credit for all recorded PP points/game, including below the PP sample threshold.
seasonComparisonGroup: Same season and NHL position; eligible five-on-five players.
historicalComparisonGroup: Same latest recorded NHL position within the historical window; players with at least one eligible season.
historicalAggregation: Equal average of available eligible season indices, followed by historical percentile calculation.
percentileMethod: 100 * (number below + half the number tied) / group size. Uses unrounded indices.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal.
note: Descriptive offensive ratings only. Not overall player value or projected performance. Zero index is not the combined league average; 10.0 can result from percentile rounding.
